summary.zh: 将已识别威胁对应到安全控制措施
summary.en: Map identified threats to security controls and mitigations.

description.zh: 把威胁建模中列出的风险逐条对应到具体的安全控制和缓解方案，并排出优先级与实施顺序。适合安排安全投入、编制整改计划，或复核现有控制是否真的有效。
description.en: Turns the threats from a threat model into concrete security controls and mitigations, with priorities and a remediation order. Useful when budgeting security work, writing a remediation plan, or checking whether existing controls hold.
